rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
# pkg-config is only there under the name with the system type in front, # which meson does not look for in a build without a cross file. # # Don't pass -Di18n=disabled, the build files of 1.7.0 don't cope with it. CC="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" PKG_CONFIG="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" \ meson setup \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --sbindir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin" \ --buildtype=plain \ --default-library=both \ -Daudit=enabled \ -Dselinux=enabled \ -Ddocs=disabled \ -Deconf=disabled \ -Dexamples=false \ -Dlogind=disabled \ -Dnis=disabled \ -Dpam_userdb=disabled \ . "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" meson install --no-rebuild
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/pam.d"
install -m 644 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/etc/pam.conf" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/" install -m 644 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/etc/pam.d/other" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/pam.d/"
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR"
